The shirt showcases a symphony of embellishments on a chiffon base. The neckline is hand-embellished with white beads, pearls, and transparent sequins. The front panel features intricate handmade embroidery. The design is echoed on the side panels. Adorning the hem are embroidered silk borders. The sleeves are not left behind, with richly embroidered chiffon matched with ornate borders.

Then comes a pair of dyed silk trousers, which maintain a sleek and refined look. The trousers are highlighted by an embroidered border that mirrors the opulence of the shirt's detailing. The outfit is completed with a luxurious net dupatta, bordered with white-on-white embroidery, which drapes beautifully, enhancing the outfit’s overall grace. 

1- Short Shirt with Crushed Gharara:
Shirt: 

The hand-embellished neckline is stitched with silver shimmering joint lace. The neck is enhanced by handmade beads accessories. The puffed sleeves become fitted at the embroidered border giving a sleek look. There is a motif and beads hand-made tassel at the back of the neck. The border of the shirt is enhanced by handmade hanging scalloped fabric design and bead tassels. The side vents of the shirt also have organza loops that gives a luminous look.

Dupatta:

The dupatta gives a luminous look with its white-on-white embroidered borders enhanced by joint lace.

 Gharara:

The crushed gharara is adorned with silver gotta lace all over the fabric. The borders are enhanced by silver kiran lace.  

2- Long Shirt with Trouser:
Shirt: 

The hand-embellished neckline is stitched with silver shimmering joint lace. The neck is enhanced by handmade bead accessories. The bell-shaped sleeve edges are enhanced with white pearls. The border of the shirt and side vents are enhanced by white bead accessories at the edges. 

Dupatta:

The dupatta gives a luminous look with its white-on-white embroidered borders enhanced by joint lace. 

Trouser:

The base is dyed silk, offering a sleek, smooth silhouette that complements the elaborate upper designs.

Silk fabric with digital prints and subtle sequins, tailored to offer a churidar silhouette.

Dupatta: 

Matches the shirt with additional decorative elements like copper-colored kiran lace and chatta patti, enriched with tassels and handmade beads.
